effects: Pulls exactly `assets` USD₮0 from the signer into the vault with transferFrom, spending the signer's USD₮0 allowance to the vault.
Mints feUSDT0v2 shares to `onBehalf`. The share count is computed by previewDeposit from the share price after interest and fee accrual.
The vault may then move the deposited USD₮0 into its liquidity adapter. This is internal to the vault and does not change what the signer gets.
formats.shown: Deposit of the exact USD₮0 amount, a constant 'Share ticker: feUSDT0v2' line, and the address that receives the shares. The number of shares is not shown.

findings.title: deposit: the number of feUSDT0v2 shares minted is not shown because the contract computes it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit(): `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. Case 0 mints 112242276000000000000 feUSDT0v2 to the signer. The screen names only the share ticker and the recipient.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. The descriptor already names the share token and the recipient.

findings.title: deposit: a separate constant 'Share ticker' field adds a line that could be part of the recipient label.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit field {label 'Share ticker', format raw, value $.metadata.constants.vaultTicker}. Case 0 screen shows 'Share ticker: feUSDT0v2' as its own row.
findings.fix: Drop the constant field and label the recipient 'Send feUSDT0v2 shares to', or put the share token in the intent.

cases.notes: USD₮0 out (112.242276) is shown exactly. The approval event is the allowance spent by the same transferFrom, so it is merged into that transfer. The share recipient and ticker are shown, but not the share amount; the reader saw that the amount was missing.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns feUSDT0v2 shares from `onBehalf`. The count is computed by previewWithdraw (rounded up) from the share price after accrual.
When the signer is not `onBehalf`, the burned shares are taken from the signer's share allowance from `onBehalf`.
Sends exactly `assets` USD₮0 from the vault to `receiver`, pulling from the liquidity adapter first when idle assets are short.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly N USD₮0 to the receiver, with the owner whose shares are burned. The number of shares burned is not shown.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of feUSDT0v2 shares burned from the owner is computed and not shown.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw(): `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(...)`, and exit() calls `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. Case 1 burns 500000000000000000000 feUSDT0v2 from the signer. The screen shows only '500 USD₮0' and the Owner address.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. A label such as 'Owner (shares burned from)' would make it clearer that shares leave this address.

cases.notes: USD₮0 in (500, to the signer) is exact and was understood right. The reader expected the position to shrink but did not know it was 500 feUSDT0v2 shares, because the share amount is not shown.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns exactly `shares` feUSDT0v2 from `onBehalf`, spending the signer's share allowance when the signer is not `onBehalf`.
Sends USD₮0 from the vault to `receiver`. The amount is computed by previewRedeem from the share price after accrual, and the call takes no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem N feUSDT0v2 shares to the receiver, with the owner. Neither the asset paid out nor its amount is shown.

findings.title: redeem: the USD₮0 amount paid to the receiver is computed and has no minimum in calldata.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem(): `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);`. Case 2 pays 10000000 (10 USD₮0) to the signer. The screen shows no output amount.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never names USD₮0 as the asset received, so the reader had to guess it.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem fields: 'Shares to redeem', 'To', 'Owner'. The underlyingTicker constant exists but is not used. Case 2 reader: 'Which token is paid out; presumably USDT0 from the name but not stated'.
findings.fix: Label the receiver 'Receive USD₮0 at', or set interpolatedIntent to 'Redeem {#.shares} for USD₮0 to {#.receiver}'.

cases.notes: The 10 feUSDT0v2 shares out are exact. The reader inferred that USD₮0 arrives at their own address but did not know the asset for sure or the amount (10).
